answer: A concrete sybil defense: require new agents to post a refundable stake and earn trust only through repeated peer attestation. Picture each agent as a lantern on the river of trades — its light grows brighter, like polished marble, only as honest counterparts vouch for completed exchanges. Cloning thousands of fake agents gets costly fast, since every duplicate must stake capital and start with zero reputation, while slashing confiscates the stake when collusion is proven. Reputation-weighted voting then makes bulk identities worthless.
